name: codex-home-autopatch
description: Deprecated: split CODEX_HOME makes codex CLI usage awkward; migrate before installing Codex Workspace Filter.

codex-home-autopatch.linkEntries.description: Entries under ~/.codex to link into the per-workspace CODEX_HOME. (Restart the extension host after changing this setting.)

codex-home-autopatch.copyEntries.description: Entries under ~/.codex to copy into the per-workspace CODEX_HOME when the destination does not exist. (Restart the extension host after changing this setting.)
